scripts.i18n:pot: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/od-icon-collection wp i18n make-pot . languages/od-icon-collection.pot --domain=od-icon-collection --exclude=vendor,node_modules,dist,.cache,tests,scripts,docs
scripts.i18n:mo: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/od-icon-collection wp i18n make-mo languages
scripts.test:php: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/od-icon-collection php vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit.xml.dist
